fact_text: The farm owner said he first ran a dairy in 2001, stepped away after a few years to work in his father's rice export business, and took the current farm site in 2017 with 100 animals.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said the herd had grown to about 400 animals by the publication date, a mix of buffaloes and cows.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The farm sells its milk to a wholesaler under a yearly contract, and the supply commitment runs until December, when a new agreement is signed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said feed quality sets milk quality, and the ration is built from five to seven ingredients: broken wheat, wheat bran, rice polish, mustard cake, Malaysian palm kernel cake and pulse husks.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said each milking animal eats about 10 kg of dry feed a day, given in two feedings, with straw and green fodder supplied on top of that.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said individual animals yield about 5 to 8 kg of milk per milking, but the farm's own calculation averages about 9 kg per animal over 24 hours.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said productive life varies from about six months to several years, but the farm averages about 9 to 10 months per animal.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner named lumpy skin disease as a main herd risk and said four or five vaccines run on a continuing schedule, repeated about every three months.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The herd includes Nili-Ravi and Sindh buffaloes, Sahiwal-cross and Friesian-cross cows, and local animals; heifers born on the farm are kept as replacements.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said cows make up roughly 20 to 25 percent of the herd and buffaloes about 75 percent, blended so that the milk fat level stays near 6 percent.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said animals are let out into fresh open air after feeding and milking, which he believes keeps them healthy and supports steady milk production.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said milk with fat above 6 percent sells easily and buyers come to the farm, so the farm does not need to go looking for customers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said the farm plans to hold its existing herd size rather than expand or exit, because dairy is hard to leave once costs and farmer debt mount.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: Fresh pure milk in Karachi is sold at the commissioner's notified retail rate, which the owner put at about PKR 240.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said fresh milk is the only food item in Karachi sold at the commissioner's notified rate, and no other food is priced that way.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: A medium-quality buffalo or cow was said to cost about PKR 6.5 to 7 lakh in the market, and the owner said better-grade buffaloes are scarce.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner blamed the buffalo shortage on the lack of a livestock policy, which pushes dry animals to slaughter because Karachi farms lack space to keep non-milking stock.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said powder- and chemical-based milk fills the gap between supply and demand and sells for about PKR 150 to 200 per kg, a price poorer buyers accept.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said the biggest problem for Karachi dairy farmers is not finding a buyer for their milk but getting a fair farm-gate rate for it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said animals ran short in the final two days before Eid al-Adha in 2026, so farmers sold cheaply while traders resold to buyers at about double the price.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said he met Mohammad Ali Malkani and asked for land to move dry animals; the official said suitable land near Bamore was available but no allotment had yet been made.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said a dairy run on a calculated 12-month basis is profitable, but farms that borrow for feed and animals can slip into losses, so inputs should be bought in cash.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner argued Karachi dairy should move toward cow farming, since cow milk is widely used worldwide and would not need to cost consumers more.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said buffalo milk is preferred in Pakistan for its higher fat, which gives a richer taste for tea, kheer, butter, desi ghee and lassi, though he called cow milk more beneficial.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)

fact_text: The owner said the best buffaloes come from the Badin area of Sindh, and the farm also buys stock from Mallu Mor, Gujrat, Salam market and Chichawatni in Punjab.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Dar Dairy Farm Built a 400+ Animal Dairy Business in Pakistan | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-03)
